head: 0003ff431b77106238d23b7a75b7450c3582428e
summary: Approved. Round-1 F-01, F-02 and F-03 are fully closed by the separate b5af8f2 and 191cc07 commits. The rounded-tie fixture now owns a cryptographically random quoted schema, fails rather than adopting a collision, and cleans only that schema. Two real concurrent PG19 executions passed while a pre-existing sentinel survived and no generated schemas remained. The exact freeze-qa path and all stale roadmap status/scope/navigation statements are corrected. The owner-approved SC-1 re-freeze chain is internally consistent: accepted base-reFreeze-3 is ready, all five reFreeze-3-feature records are 0/pass/complete, the independent acceptance review is approved, and accepted base/feature/current harness bytes match. These are re-freeze validation results, not the still-pending final feature-r1 QA. Focused query, replay, registry and TUI checks pass, and no new cross-task regression or substantive finding remains.

round_1_finding_closure.evidence: The commit changes only internal/query/autovacuum_scores_test.go. Current lines 190-198 exercise 64 random schema names; lines 214-221 use crypto/rand plus hex, pgx.Identifier.Sanitize, plain CREATE SCHEMA and cleanup of only the generated schema. All former fixed public-schema DROP TABLE statements are gone. In a fresh network-none PG19 container, two concurrent invocations of Test_StatAutovacuumScoresQuery_RoundedTieRawOrder and Test_AutovacuumScoresRoundedTieSchemaUniqueness both ran and passed, including both raw_descending_score_order_survives_rounded_ties subtests. A precreated public.pgcenter_test_autovacuum_score_low sentinel containing id=42 still had exactly that row after both runs; pg_namespace contained zero pgcenter_autovacuum_scores_% schemas after cleanup. The disposable container was removed and no review containers remained.

The decomposition now gives exactly ${KIMI_CODE_HOME}/skills/freeze-qa/scripts/run-acceptance.sh docs/features/018-feat-tables-autovacuum-area/acceptance feature-r1 900. The duplicated feature directory is absent, and the single-component acceptance directory exists. No acceptance runner was invoked by this review.

docs/roadmap-0.12.0.md lines 344-368 now state that implementation/freeze are complete while feature-r1 and manual SC-5 through SC-8 remain pending. Scope is limited to tables/indexes with functions explicitly unchanged; PG19 t/T and below-PG19 disabled-menu behavior match the code; functions.go is removed from plumbing.
